Wait — maybe the notice board is actually at (2,7) but I should be able to read it by standing at (2,6) or (2,8) facing it. But I can't get there.

Let me try a completely fresh approach — maybe the game resets or the player can help. Let me observe the player and see if the player moves. Actually, let me just try waiting longer and re-attempting movement, in case there's a periodic unstick.
